name: Salesforce
description: Pinned Salesforce REST CRM records, custom scalar fields, metadata and bounded collections.

permissions.description: Makes explicitly scoped HTTPS Salesforce REST requests using an externally supplied OAuth token; confirmed writes can alter CRM records. No token acquisition or refresh.

definitions.name: Create Record Collection
definitions.documentation: Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Record Collection. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_COLLECTION_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Update Record Collection
definitions.documentation: Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Record Collection. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_COLLECTION_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Upsert Record Collection
definitions.documentation: Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Record Collection. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_COLLECTION_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Delete Record Collection
definitions.documentation: Salesforce REST API v68.0. Delete Record Collection. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_COLLECTION_DELETE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying.
